    called_party = 'R',
    status = 'Called',
    primary_winner = 'Pete Ricketts',
    primary_party = 'R'
WHERE state_code = 'NE' AND candidate2_party = 'R';

       called_winner, called_party, status, primary_winner, primary_party
FROM senate_races WHERE state_code = 'NE';
